items.exampleEn: The regional manager visits our branch once a month.
items.exampleZh: 區域經理每個月來我們分店一次。

items.exampleEn: Our town will choose a new mayor in May.
items.exampleZh: 我們鎮五月要選出新鎮長。

items.exampleEn: The ship stayed in port for two days.
items.exampleZh: 那艘船在港口停了兩天。

items.exampleEn: The platform was crowded with students.
The sun disappeared below the horizon.
The northwest of the country is very dry.
items.exampleZh: 該國的西北部非常乾燥。

items.exampleEn: Strong winds came from the southwest last night.
items.exampleZh: 昨晚強風從西南方吹來。

items.exampleEn: Most of the rain in this country falls in the southeast.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家大部分的雨下在東南部。

items.sentenceEn: Please wait for the train on the other platform.
items.sentenceZh: 請在另一個月台等火車。

items.audioEn: Boats from the port leave every hour for the island. The last one leaves at six.
items.audioZh: 往島上的船每小時從港口出發一班，最後一班六點開。

items.sentenceEn: The mayor wants more trees in the city center.
items.sentenceZh: 市長希望市中心有更多樹。

items.sentenceEn: We could see a small boat on the horizon.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看得到地平線上有一艘小船。

items.stemEn: The train to the airport leaves from ____ 2.
items.stemZh: 往機場的火車從第 2 月台出發。

items.stemEn: Our company has a ____ office in each big city.
items.stemZh: 我們公司在每個大城市都設有區域辦公室。

items.passageEn: The town of Bayport sits on the southeast coast. Its busy port receives ships with goods from many countries. Last year, the mayor opened a new train station with four platforms. Regional trains now go northwest to the mountains and southwest to the beaches. The student union at the local college often organizes trips by train. In the evening, many people walk by the sea and watch the ships on the horizon.
items.passageZh: Bayport 鎮位於東南海岸。鎮上忙碌的港口接收來自許多國家、載著貨物的船。去年，鎮長啟用了一座有四個月台的新火車站。區域列車現在往西北通往山區，往西南通往海灘。當地大學的學生會常常辦搭火車的旅行。傍晚時，許多人在海邊散步，看地平線上的船。

questions.questionZh: 往西南方的列車通往哪裡？

referenceEn: The airport is southwest of the city.
The airport is to the southwest of the city.
rubricZh: 可寫，例如 southwest of…、to the southwest of… 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 學生會每年舉辦一場音樂會。
referenceEn: The student union holds a concert every year.
Every year, the student union organizes a concert.
rubricZh: 用 student union 表示「學生會」（寫 student council 也正確）
